outcome: Simulate and balance currency, progression, supply, sinks and offers against long-term player value — with age, spend and cooling rules as hard constraints
overview: Game economies drift: currency inflates, progression stalls, offers confuse, and aggressive tactics buy a quarter of revenue at the cost of years of player trust. This solution simulates currency sources, sinks, prices and progression before a season ships, tests design options against long-term value rather than next-week conversion, and enforces age, region, spend-cap and cooling rules as hard constraints. Offer approval, monetisation policy and any judgement about vulnerable or underage players remain with the customer’s product, legal and child-safety owners. An 8–12-week diagnostic and controlled test validates economy stability with wellbeing and complaint measures as balancing metrics. Reference builds are specified for AWS and Azure.

benefits.text: Improve economy stability — currency inflation and progression pacing held within agreed bands
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Simulation is only as good as the economy model; validated by back-testing against the customer’s own past seasons before any live change

benefits.text: Reduce complaints about confusing, spammy or high-pressure offers
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on the customer adopting transparent pricing and offer-frequency caps; complaint volume also moves with unrelated content changes

benefits.text: Enforce age, region, spend-cap, cooling-off and refund rules as constraints the design cannot bypass
benefits.source: Reference architecture policy-constraint design, Redington Gaming catalogue
benefits.limits: The constraint layer enforces the rules the customer defines; setting those rules, and all responsibility for minors and vulnerable players, remains with the customer’s legal, product and child-safety owners

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); transaction, entitlement and economy telemetry remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: No transaction and economy telemetry — sources, sinks and balances are not recorded
notFor.why: Simulation needs the actual flow of currency and items; without it the model is an assumption, not a diagnosis
Spending-pressure mechanics are not appropriate for minors; the constraint layer blocks age-inappropriate offers by design, so a child-first title has no eligible commercial surface to optimise

notFor.situation: A brief to maximise short-term revenue without balancing measures
notFor.why: The solution optimises long-term contribution under wellbeing and trust constraints; it is not a tool for extracting more from high-spending players and will not be scoped that way

scope:
Model: Joint delivery: accredited implementation partner leads, with Redington architecture and commercial governance; the customer owns monetisation policy, offer approval, consumer-protection compliance and all responsibility for minors and vulnerable players · Duration: 8–12-week diagnostic and controlled test; further 14–24 weeks to portfolio scale
Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, economy data scientist, monetisation design consultant; customer economy designer, product and monetisation owner, finance analyst, legal, child-safety and player-advocacy reviewers · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation
1) Discovery and economy baseline agreement
2) Transaction and economy telemetry integration
3) Currency, sink and progression model build with season back-test
4) Policy-constraint and approval-workflow configuration
5) Controlled season test with player research
6) Stabilisation and handover
deliverables: Economy back-test reproduces past seasons within the agreed error band
Age, region, spend-cap and cooling-off controls verified, including the unconfirmed-age default
Player research completed and reviewed alongside telemetry
Experiment validity confirmed and refund and reconciliation flows tested end to end
Legal, consumer-protection and child-safety user-acceptance testing complete
